correctedState: Correct as filed, with two refinements. (a) Scope: the gap covers every instruction/memory layer our own loader reads — AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md (capabilities/native-sources.ts:82), MEMORY.md and .agents/rules files — whose bodies reach the model through composePinnedCapabilityContext (base-agent.ts:960-1015). The only content ever removed there is `@import` lines from memory layers and `paths:` frontmatter from rule files; the only `<!-- -->` handling anywhere in shared source is stripAutoMemoryMarkers (memory-store.ts:161-163), which matches exactly `<!-- nessy:auto:YYYY-MM-DD -->`. (b) A fix must honour the doc's two qualifiers on the same line — comments inside fenced code blocks are PRESERVED, and the Read tool must still show comments (so stripping belongs at injection, not at file read) — and the same stripping is required before the auto-memory load limit is measured (memory.md:388), which readMemoryFile (memory-store.ts:29-33) also does not do today; it also still lacks the 25 KB half of that limit.
